blocks.text: Thank you for turning the access request around so quickly; Brenda Rodriguez had the cost extract open first thing. One point from her early look is worth flagging while it is still small. The ledger your team sent groups two of the {{fact:f:E-2008-001.client}} support functions under a single cost center, which means we cannot yet see what each of them actually consumes. It is worth correcting before the rest of the baseline is built on top of it, and Brenda can tell your finance team exactly what she needs to split the two.

A couple of things would help from here. If someone on your finance side can re-cut those two functions into separate lines, or simply point Brenda Rodriguez to where the underlying detail sits, we can keep the cost picture moving without waiting on a full re-post. And I would still like to hold the thirty minutes each with the two process managers; if the introductions are easier coming from you, I am glad for those requests to go out under your name. I know this all lands on you, Linda Gallegos, in a week that is likely already full, and I have kept the asks as small as the work allows.

For speed, send whatever is easiest directly to me, Jason Torres, and I will get it to Brenda the same day; I will keep this thread as the running record so nothing has to be chased twice. I will hold the two process-manager sessions open in my calendar for late next week.
